title: A Horizon for the Static
author: Ulyana Brightwater
blurb: Orsen Winterbourne, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
